summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its share buyback program: it purchased 12,135,869 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 97.7943 pence per share on 28 April 2026, as part of a pre-existing program announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. This is a routine disclosure of an open-market buyback execution and does not involve a tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situations event. No action or recommendation is required.
